description: Universum Explicatum - Getting to know international challenges for academic success
summary: We developed a simple, yet challenging game that makes you plan and command a lunar or martian mission, where you can choose an assistant and diferent gear at the beginning, that will help you throughout the whole game. The gameplay is simple: you are presented with various problems, decisions or requests, that will give you two answers, to choose between them, each having consequences illustrated by the stats. The objective of the game is to balance your stats, so that none of them get too low and causes the failure of your misson, until the 20 days end.
details: Our project is a simple game made to train people interested in the astronaut path to help with the decision taking involved, while mantaining the language appropriate and easy to understand for the infant-juvenile audience, taking light inspiration from video-games such as "60 Seconds" and "Reigns", that present you with hard choices to survive or mantain your position. The diary-like style of the game and the stat system are examples of inspired elements, respectively. We used Python and HTML for the project, using VS Code and GitHub as platforms and AIs such as Claude to help clean and improve the code, although most of it and all of the creative proccess had no AI involvement. We had difficuties to make the project, such as it being our first Hackathon, tests and the ENEM exam (since we are on the 10th Grade, 1st Grade of high school in Brazil) and time availability, yet we pushed through with this project made with our own hard work.
